title: 第23章 吞噬魔气第24章 天魔教圣女
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
“怎么回事，阵法怎么又恢复了？”
见到即将消失的阵法又突然凝聚，在场的人都露出吃惊之色。
“哼，我就不信破不了，给我攻击。”
长须老者见状，暴怒不已。
当下带着阴阳学宫的学员，开始猛烈攻击。
然而这次不管他们怎么攻击，阵法都纹丝不动。
楚啸天见到这一幕，也惊呆了。
当下转头看着灰袍老者道：“韦长老，这是怎么回事？”
灰袍老者看着眼前的阵法，也愣住了。
“怎么回事，这阵法刚才明明已经快要消失了，怎么又突然恢复了？”
“难道……”
“难道什么？”
楚啸天问道。
灰袍老者道：“估计是有高人在暗中相助。”
“高人暗中相助？”
楚啸天皱眉。
仔细想了想，发现他们楚家好像并不认识什么高人。
不过不管对方是什么人，只要出手帮助他们楚家，那就是好人。
轰轰轰！
在长须老者的带领下，上百名阴阳学宫学员连续进攻数个时辰，但阵法都是纹丝不动。

“怎么回事，这阵法怎么感觉越攻击越强。”
“是啊，我也感觉到了。”
长须老者此刻也看出了不对劲。
当下停下手中动作，看着周围怒喝道：“何人在帮助楚家，这是我们阴阳学宫和楚家的事，希望你不要插手。”
长须老者在周围扫视一圈，发现没有人后，正要收回目光，突然转头看向身后。
只见他身后阁楼顶上，不知何时站着一名青袍少年。
少年脸色阴沉，垂落肩头的长发，在微风中飘荡。
“楚……楚云，是楚云，他回来了。”
青袍少年，正是赶回来的楚云。
见到楚家人安然无恙，他轻轻松了一口气。
不过眼前这阵法，能够抵挡住地武境这么多次攻击，他感觉不正常。
不过眼下不是追究这个的时候。
而是要想办法解决眼前这些人。
“楚云，想不到你来的这么及时。”
长须老者见到楚云，并没有惊慌。
因为根据得到的消息，楚云只有地武境九重修为。
而他也是地武境九重，两人都是同级，就算杀不死对方，他要想逃走，对方也拿他没有办法。
楚云道：“真是没有想到，阴阳学宫这么卑鄙，杀不了我，就派人来对付我的家族。”
content_en:
"What's going on? Why has the formation been restored again?"
Seeing that the formation that was about to disappear suddenly condensed again, everyone present was surprised.
"Hmph, I don't believe it can't be broken, just attack me."
The old man with a long beard was furious when he saw this.
At that moment, the students from Yin Yang Academy began to attack fiercely.
However, no matter how they attacked this time, the formation remained motionless.
Chu Xiaotian was also shocked when he saw this scene.
Then he turned to look at the old man in gray robe and said, "Elder Wei, what's going on?"
The old man in gray robe was also stunned when he looked at the formation in front of him.
"What's going on? This formation was about to disappear just now, why did it suddenly recover again?"
"Could it be..."
"What?"
Chu Xiaotian asked.
The old man in gray robe said: "I guess there are experts helping me secretly."
"Experts secretly helping?"
Chu Xiaotian frowned.
After thinking about it carefully, I found that the Chu family didn't seem to know any experts.
But no matter who the other person is, as long as he helps the Chu family, he is a good person.
Boom boom boom!
Under the leadership of the long-bearded old man, hundreds of Yin-Yang Academy students attacked continuously for several hours, but the formation remained motionless.
"What's going on? Why does this formation feel like it's getting stronger with more attacks?"
"Yeah, I feel it too."
The long-bearded old man also saw something was wrong at this moment.
He immediately stopped what he was doing, looked around and shouted angrily: "Who is helping the Chu family? This is a matter between our Yin Yang Academy and the Chu family. I hope you will not interfere."
The long-bearded old man glanced around and found no one. He was about to look away when he suddenly turned his head and looked behind him.
I saw a young man in green robe standing on the roof of the attic behind him.
The young man's face was gloomy, and his long hair fell down on his shoulders, fluttering in the breeze.
"Chu...Chu Yun, it's Chu Yun, he's back."
The young man in green robe is Chu Yun who rushed back.
Seeing that the Chu family was safe and sound, he breathed a sigh of relief.
However, he felt that it was abnormal for the formation in front of him to be able to withstand so many attacks from the Earth Martial Realm.
But now is not the time to pursue this.
But to find a way to deal with these people in front of you.
"Chu Yun, I didn't expect you to come in such a timely manner."
The long-bearded old man did not panic when he saw Chu Yun.
Because according to the information he received, Chu Yun was only at the ninth level of Earth Martial Realm.
And he was also at the ninth level of the Earth Martial Realm. They were both at the same level. Even if they couldn't kill each other, if he wanted to escape, there was nothing the other party could do to him.
Chu Yun said: "I really didn't expect that Yin Yang Academy would be so despicable. They couldn't kill me, so they sent people to deal with my family."
